scope: network-wide-first classification of remaining active Italy CPOs

results.tariffChannel: direct CPO app pay-per-use; subscriptions separate
positiveEvidence: Current first-party Magis FAQ states pay-per-use cost is calculated from the tariff shown in the app at time of use.

Current first-party subscription page exposes deterministic subscription tariffs: Small AC 0.60 EUR/kWh + 5 EUR/month; Medium AC 0.58 + 10/month; Large AC 0.50 + 20/month; Flat DC 0.74 + 10/month, plus combined plans.
results.decision: Do not promote a national pay-per-use tariff. Keep deterministic subscription products as separate eligibility-bound offers; direct pay-per-use requires connector/station mapping from app/backend.

positiveEvidence: Coop Liguria/Coop Power installations operated with Nucleo have publicly reported tariffs starting at 0.39 EUR/kWh AC and 0.49 EUR/kWh DC/ultrafast and support card/Charge Assist payment.
results.decision: Evidence is tied to the Coop Power sub-network/locations and uses 'starting at'; it does not prove party-wide applicability across all Nucleo EVSE. Require site/EVSE mapping before rankable use.

Current UnoEnergy public material found describes private charging economics and hardware but does not establish a current deterministic public-network tariff for all DRW EVSE. Do not transpose illustrative household-energy costs.

Legacy ZapGrid pages expose operator/location tariffs (e.g. MP NEXT 0.35 EUR/kWh, ASM Voghera 0.40 EUR/kWh), demonstrating tenant/operator-specific pricing rather than one GMT network tariff. Current party-wide direct tariff not proven.

results.canonicalName: WROOM SRL SB a socio unico
results.decision: Available tariff tables identify Wroom chiefly as an eMSP price option on other CPO networks, not proof of a native deterministic tariff for the WRM physical partyId. Keep direct CPO scope fail-closed pending first-party station/backend mapping.
